title: Context Packet
description: The declaration a submitter makes before any capability is invoked: what code will run, over which exact bytes, with which permissions, and what must be true afterwards.

packet_id.description: Submitter-chosen label. NOT an identity: two packets may share it. Identity is the run_id.

capsule.description: Name of a registered capsule. Unregistered names are refused; there is no arbitrary-command endpoint.

path.description: Path relative to the context root. Absolute paths and '..' segments are refused.

sha256.description: Declared digest. The runtime hashes the real file at provision time and refuses to execute on mismatch.

capabilities.description: Permissions granted to the capsule. A capsule whose required set is not a subset of this list is refused before execution.

output.description: Name of a declared capsule output.

path.description: Dot path into that output's parsed value. Empty string selects the whole value.

postconditions.description: Declarative only. There is no expression evaluation and no eval() anywhere in this runtime.
